comment: Demolition plan notes do not address required safety clearances from transmission lines: pre-construction safety meeting with Austin Energy 48 hours before work commencement, barricades erected 10 feet from transmission structures, warning signs under overhead facilities, and prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement. applicableAreas: demolition work areas near at-grade utility appurtenances

comment: Transformer pads shown on the preliminary electrical design plan lack required specification and documentation. Pad dimensions must be sized per AE Design specifications (UCM § 1.5.2.6 requires customer to furnish pad per AE Design based on customer's AutoCAD site drawings). Each pad must be encumbered by a dedicated AE easement and protected by a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement (UCM § 1.10.10.3). Coordinate with Austin Energy to obtain final pad dimensions and establish recorded utility easements for each pad.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 (west side, between Buildings 1 and 8)
Transformer Pad 2 (east side, between Buildings 4 and 6)

comment: The site plan identifies utility easements but does not include copies of required License Agreements or City Manager licenses. Items placed within private AE easements require a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement per UCM § 1.10.10.3. Items within public utility easements or public ROW require a City Manager license per § 14-11-41. Submit copies of all required licensing documentation for any structures, paving, or landscaping proposed within recorded easement boundaries before approval.
applicableAreas: Utility easement boundaries throughout property (perimeter and interior)

comment: The property was previously developed with an assisted living facility (demolished June 2022). Abandoned utility infrastructure from the prior use may remain on site or in ROW.
